title: Grateful Dead Live at William and Mary College Hall on 1973-09-12

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of an early‑fall ’73 show that’s solid and jammy (Let It Grow, Loose Lucy), but with some funky audio moments.
ai_review.review: The performance is a respectable snapshot of the September‑October 1973 tour – tight from recent studio work, highlighted by a jazzy Let It Grow with horns and a loose, jam‑heavy Loose Lucy. The SBD source is generally clear, though reviewers note occasional “funky” audio quirks that keep it from being pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating ~3.6 across nine reviews, with many positive comments about the music and only modest criticism of the recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear SBD, but a few reviewers mention funky or uneven audio moments that detract slightly from an otherwise listenable mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑fall ’73 set feels tight from recent studio sessions, with added horn textures for Let It Grow; overall the show is a bit slower than classic ’73 peaks but remains jam‑focused and enjoyable.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise Jerry’s crystal tone and his free‑form noodling during jams.
